usage.callShape: GET https://api.auor.io/ip-stack/v1/lookup?ip={ipv4_or_ipv6} (IP as query param, no request body)
usage.outputShape: Top-level body: body.country_name, body.country_code, body.region_name, body.region_code, body.city, body.zip, body.latitude, body.longitude, body.continent_name, body.type; nested body.location.{geoname_id, capital, languages[], country_flag, country_flag_emoji, calling_code, is_eu}
quirks: IP is passed as a URL query parameter (?ip=8.8.8.8), there is no request body
Method is GET — do not send POST

Response is ipstack-format with all fields at the TOP LEVEL (body.country_name, body.city, body.latitude). This differs from the 2s.io backend recorded in prior existingUsage which double-nests under body.data.items[0] — for THIS auor.io endpoint read fields off body directly
usage.guide: Call GET https://api.auor.io/ip-stack/v1/lookup?ip=8.8.8.8 (substitute any IPv4 or IPv6) via x402 on Base at $0.001 USDC per call. Pass the IP as the ?ip= query parameter; there is no request body and no auth/sign-in. The geolocation result comes back as ipstack-format JSON with fields at the top level: read body.country_name, body.region_name, body.city, body.zip, body.latitude, body.longitude directly, plus body.location for extras like calling_code and country_flag_emoji. Plain synchronous response, no polling.
